title: Design System: Segato — Control de Gastos

display.purpose: Monetary totals and balance figures. The largest text on screen. 800 weight is reserved strictly for financial amounts.

headline.purpose: Major section totals in stats. One per view maximum.

title.purpose: Sheet titles, modal headers. Marks a context change.

body.purpose: Transaction descriptions (600 weight primary) and secondary metadata (400 weight). Primary reading size throughout the list.

label.purpose: Form field labels, tab bar labels, chip text. 13px, 600 weight.

caption.purpose: Summary card column headers. Uppercase permitted here only — three-word financial column headers at 11px.

shadows.name: ambient-low
shadows.value: shadowColor: #000, shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 2 }, shadowOpacity: 0.30, shadowRadius: 4, elevation: 3
shadows.purpose: Subtle surface lift for non-AMOLED rendering (web, Electron on light OS).

shadows.name: ambient-mid
shadows.value: shadowColor: #000, shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 4 }, shadowOpacity: 0.40, shadowRadius: 8, elevation: 6
shadows.purpose: Heavier lift for dialogs and sheets in non-AMOLED contexts.

shadows.name: accent-glow
shadows.value: shadowColor: #5B7CF6, shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 4 }, shadowOpacity: 0.35, shadowRadius: 12, elevation: 8
shadows.purpose: FAB only. The sole colored shadow in the system. Anchors the primary action above scrolling content.

motion.name: press-feedback
motion.value: immediate background color shift, no animation
motion.purpose: Row and button press states. Firmness is the interaction language — no spring, no bounce, no delay.

motion.name: sheet-slide
motion.purpose: Bottom sheet entrance for modals, dropdowns. Slides up from off-screen.

motion.name: list-entry
motion.purpose: Transaction row entrance via Reanimated. Used for swipeable list items.

motion.name: standard-transition
motion.purpose: State transitions: tab changes, navigation. Short; users are in task flow.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.behavior: Bottom tab bar, single-column form, full-width sheets

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.behavior: Wider layout, 2-column form in sheets, FAB at 32px margins

breakpoints.name: desktop
breakpoints.behavior: Left sidebar (220px), tab bar hidden, sheets as centered dialogs (max 720px)

components.name: Floating Action Button
components.description: Primary action trigger. Adds a new transaction. Fixed bottom-right; the only element with an accent glow shadow.
components.html: <button class="ds-fab" aria-label="Add transaction"><svg width="26" height="26" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="white" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"><line x1="12" y1="5" x2="12" y2="19"/><line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-fab { width: 58px; height: 58px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #5B7CF6; border: none; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(91,124,246,0.35); transition: background 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-fab:hover { background: #4A68DC; box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(91,124,246,0.45); } .ds-fab:active { background: #4A68DC; transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-fab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5B7CF6; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-tx-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 13px 16px; background: #000000; border-bottom: 1px solid #111111; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.1s; } .ds-tx-row:hover, .ds-tx-row:active { background: #1E1E1E; } .ds-tx-avatar { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 10px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-tx-avatar-letter { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-tx-body { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; min-width: 0; } .ds-tx-title { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #EEF2FF; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-tx-meta { font-size: 13px; color: #8895B3; } .ds-tx-amount { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-tx-expense { color: #F64458; } .ds-tx-income { color: #10D982; } .ds-tx-transfer { color: #A78BFA; } .ds-tx-loan { color: #FB923C; }

components.name: Summary Card
components.description: Three-column overview of monthly income, balance, and expenses. The largest amounts on screen use Display type (800 weight). Flanking columns use headline weight.
components.html:
INGRESOS$8,200.00
SALDO$3,750.00

components.css: .ds-summary { display: flex; align-items: center; background: #0D0D0D; border: 1px solid #202020; border-radius: 14px; padding: 16px; } .ds-summary-cell { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 5px; } .ds-summary-cap { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; color: #4E5A78; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px; } .ds-summary-val { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-summary-bal { font-size: 34px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -0.5px; } .ds-summary-div { width: 1px; height: 36px; background: #202020; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Save / confirm action. Full-width in sheet footers, always paired with the Cancel button.
components.css: .ds-btn-save { padding: 14px 20px; background: #5B7CF6; color: #EEF2FF; border: none; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; width: 100%; } .ds-btn-save:hover { background: #4A68DC; } .ds-btn-save:active { background: #4A68DC; transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-save:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5B7CF6; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Cancel Button
components.description: Dismiss / cancel action. Signals reversibility without competing visually with the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-cancel { padding: 14px 20px; background: #161616; color: #8895B3; border: none; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; width: 100%; } .ds-btn-cancel:hover { background: #1E1E1E; } .ds-btn-cancel:active { background: #1E1E1E; } .ds-btn-cancel:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8895B3; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Type Chip
components.description: Transaction type selector: expense / income / transfer. Three equal cells. Active state shows semantic color background tint, border, and text.
components.css: .ds-chip-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-chip-type { flex: 1; padding: 10px 0; background: transparent; color: #8895B3; border: 1.5px solid #202020; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-chip-expense-active { background: rgba(246,68,88,0.13); border-color: #F64458; color: #F64458; font-weight: 700; } .ds-chip-income-active { background: rgba(16,217,130,0.13); border-color: #10D982; color: #10D982; font-weight: 700; } .ds-chip-transfer-active { background: rgba(167,139,250,0.13); border-color: #A78BFA; color: #A78BFA; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text field. Surface Up background at rest; Precision Indigo border on focus. Placeholder in Ink Dim.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #8895B3; } .ds-req { color: #F64458; } .ds-input { background: #161616; border: 1px solid #202020; border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 14px; font-size: 15px; color: #EEF2FF; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #4E5A78; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #5B7CF6; } .ds-input:invalid { border-color: #F64458; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Desktop sidebar navigation. Active item: indigo background tint, indigo text, 3px right-edge indicator bar. Inactive: transparent, dim text.

narrative.overview:
Segato is built for the user who ends their day by reviewing the ledger — not to worry, but to know. The interface is a private instrument: dark by design, dense by purpose, immediate in every response. The true-black canvas (#000000) is literal: on AMOLED screens, black pixels are off and draw no power. Numbers stand in relief against the void.

The system rejects both ends of the consumer finance spectrum. Not Mint or Intuit: no notification badges competing for attention, no congratulatory messages for routine events. Not a banking app: no cold institutional palettes, no excessive whitespace. Not a SaaS dashboard: no hero metrics, no gradient text. The system most resembles a quality accounting book held in pocket form.

Color strategy is Committed. The void carries roughly 70% of every screen. Five semantic hues carry fixed financial meanings. Precision Indigo, the sole non-semantic accent, earns its rarity: it marks exactly one thing at a time.
keyCharacteristics: AMOLED-native true-black canvas — the background is the battery-saving feature
Semantic color vocabulary: every hue owns one financial meaning
Precision Indigo reserved exclusively for action and active state
System-native typeface; no display face competes with amounts
Firm, direct interactions: press feedback is immediate, transitions are short
Structurally responsive: bottom tabs on mobile, left sidebar on desktop

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Precision Indigo occupies ≤15% of any screen. A new component that reaches for indigo as decoration rather than as action or selection is wrong; rewrite it using surface colors and borders.

rules.name: The Semantic Contract
rules.body: Each hue owns exactly one financial meaning: green = income, red = expense, violet = transfer, amber = due-bill warning, orange = loan. Using any color outside its assigned meaning breaks the mental model the user built on screen one.

rules.name: The Data-First Rule
rules.body: 800 font weight is reserved for monetary amounts. No heading, label, or UI string may use 800 weight unless it is a number representing money or a derived financial figure.

rules.name: The Single Family Rule
rules.body: Adding a second font family is prohibited. The system font stack is the typeface decision. Display faces and custom fonts compete with the numbers; the numbers must win.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Tonal layering conveys structure; shadows convey state or exception. A shadow on a resting surface card or row is a design error.

dos: Do use Precision Indigo (#5B7CF6) only for primary actions, active navigation, and selection. Its rarity is its authority.
Do apply semantic colors (green, red, violet, amber, orange) strictly to their assigned financial meanings.
Do keep #000000 as the page background on every screen.
Do use 800 font weight only for monetary amounts.
Do use the four-step surface ramp (#000000 → #0D0D0D → #161616 → #1E1E1E) for all depth.
Do add the Accent Glow shadow (#5B7CF6 at 35%) to the FAB only.
Do shift press state to Surface High (#1E1E1E) instantly with no transition delay on list rows.
Do use rgba(color, 0.13–0.15) for semantic color background tints.
Do use the sidebar on desktop (≥1024px) and the bottom tab bar on mobile.
donts: Don't use Precision Indigo as a decorative fill, background wash, or illustration element.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text with a gradient).
Don't use border-left or border-right wider than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't build a hero-metric layout: large number, small label, gradient accent, stats grid.
Don't imitate Mint or Intuit: no badges competing for attention, no promotional content in the transaction flow.
Don't imitate banking apps: no cold institutional palettes, no excessive whitespace.
Don't imitate neon crypto wallets: no purple-to-cyan gradients, no glowing text or borders.
Don't add a second font family.
Don't use Warn Amber or Loan Orange outside their defined financial contexts.
Don't introduce a fifth depth level or an off-ramp surface color.
